You can try:
Checking your email (including spam) for tracking notifications.
Logging into your account to view the order details and tracking link.
Using the carrier’s tracking page (like UPS) to check for updates.
If tracking still hasn’t appeared after 10 business days, it may mean the package hasn’t been handed to the carrier yet.

Parcel or vendor‑shipped items: the delivery address cannot be changed after the order is placed. You can contact the carrier (for example, UPS) using the tracking number to request an address correction, and the carrier may charge a fee.
Nationwide furniture deliveries: address changes must be coordinated directly with the carrier once you are contacted to schedule delivery. 
Orders already in transit: the address generally cannot be changed through us, so any reroute must be requested from the carrier.
